events.title: Helen Sung
events.description: Helen Sung's debut big band album Oracles (Sunnyside Records, June 2026) pays tribute to the jazz legends who were her mentor-teachers at the Monk Institute of Jazz Performance (now the Herbie Hancock Institute), for which she composed musical portraits ranging from "A Little Bird Watchin'" for impish Jimmy Heath, "Positively CT" for the indomitable Clark Terry, "Wayne's World" [...]
